spec.rawSql:
SELECT
   time_bucket($__interval, I.end_time) as "time"
  ,CAST(SUM(WD.sum_duration_us) AS bigint) as "${BaselineSchema:text}"
FROM "${BaselineSchema:text}".WorkloadDetails WD
  JOIN "${BaselineSchema:text}".Intervals I ON WD.interval_id = I.interval_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(I.end_time)
GROUP BY time_bucket($__interval, I.end_time)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
   time_bucket($__interval, t.adj_time) as "time"
  ,CAST(SUM(WD.sum_duration_us) AS bigint) as "${BenchmarkSchema:text}"
FROM "${BenchmarkSchema:text}".WorkloadDetails WD
  JOIN "${BenchmarkSchema:text}".Intervals I ON WD.interval_id = I.interval_id
  JOIN (SELECT DATE_ADD(I.end_time, INTERVAL ${BenchmarkTimeDiff:text} MILLISECOND) as adj_time
              ,I.end_time as end_time
        FROM "${BenchmarkSchema:text}".Intervals I) t ON t.end_time = I.end_time
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.adj_time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT 
  CASE trim(A.application_name) WHEN '' THEN '-' else A.application_name END AS "Application"
  ,(CAST(SUM(WD.sum_cpu_us) AS bigint)*100.0)/(SELECT CAST(SUM(WD.sum_cpu_us) AS bigint) FROM "${BaselineSchema:text}".WorkloadDetails WD) AS "${BaselineSchema:text}"
FROM "${BaselineSchema:text}".WorkloadDetails WD
  JOIN "${BaselineSchema:text}".Applications A ON A.application_id = WD.application_id
  JOIN "${BaselineSchema:text}".Intervals I ON I.interval_id = WD.interval_id
WHERE A.application_name IN (${Application:singlequote})
  AND $__timeFilter(I.end_time)
GROUP BY A.application_name
ORDER BY "${BaselineSchema:text}" DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
   (CAST(strftime('%s', I.end_time) AS INTEGER) / (30000/1000)) * (30000/1000) AS time
  ,SUM(WD.execution_count) as 'TestozzoSQLite'
FROM WorkloadDetails WD

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket($__interval, t.adj_time) as "time"
  ,CAST(SUM(WD.execution_count) AS INTEGER) as "${BenchmarkSchema:text}"
FROM "${BenchmarkSchema:text}".WorkloadDetails WD
  JOIN "${BenchmarkSchema:text}".Intervals I ON WD.interval_id = I.interval_id
  JOIN "${BenchmarkSchema:text}".Applications A ON A.application_id = WD.application_id
  JOIN (SELECT DATE_ADD(I.end_time, INTERVAL ${BenchmarkTimeDiff:text} MILLISECOND) as adj_time
              ,I.end_time as end_time
        FROM "${BenchmarkSchema:text}".Intervals I) t ON t.end_time = I.end_time
WHERE A.application_name IN (${Application:singlequote})
  AND $__timeFilter(t.adj_time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT 
  CASE trim(D.database_name) WHEN '' THEN '-' else D.database_name END AS "Database"
  ,(CAST(SUM(WD.sum_cpu_us) AS bigint)*100.0)/(SELECT CAST(SUM(WD.sum_cpu_us) AS bigint) FROM "${BaselineSchema:text}".WorkloadDetails WD) AS "${BaselineSchema:text}"
FROM "${BaselineSchema:text}".WorkloadDetails WD
  JOIN "${BaselineSchema:text}".Databases D ON D.database_id = WD.database_id
  JOIN "${BaselineSchema:text}".Intervals I ON I.interval_id = WD.interval_id
WHERE D.database_name IN (${Database:singlequote})
  AND $__timeFilter(I.end_time)
GROUP BY D.database_name
ORDER BY "${BaselineSchema:text}" DESC
LIMIT 5
